phases.title: Some difficulty belongs to the work.
phases.description: A vast registration instrument works until one region loses its reference. The obstruction is separate from the complexity of the work.

phases.title: Some doesn’t.
phases.description: The reference is deliberately repositioned. Alignment returns and holds. The improvement remains while the camera moves on.
A spatial field resolves, then comparison structures align. The camera pulls back to reveal the retained operations. A central substrate turns forward and becomes the real ARTIFACTS homepage.
